# Expected behavior

- Record the finding briefly in active Milestone Discovered Work while ownership is undecided.
- The existing task title alone is not ownership because its Acceptance does not cover budget-exhaustion visibility.
- If the user agrees that the planned retry-metrics task owns it, add the requirement directly to that task's Acceptance and remove the Discovered Work entry.
- Otherwise keep it unowned for closure routing; do not duplicate the same concern in both places.
